[[Image:Kinso.png|250px|thumb|Kinso]] '''Kinso''' (Japanese: '''キンゾー''' ''Kinzō'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in {{g|Chronicles}}. He is an artisan who lives in [[Rifure Village]] and makes [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s. Kinso appeared in ''[[HS05|The Blue Badge of Courage]]''. When {{an|Misty}}, {{Tracey}}, and [[Sakura]] came to his cabin to get new {{Badge|Cascade}}s, they found him with an injured ankle. After administering first aid, the three were ordered by Kinso to get some exercise, make the Badges and participate in a {{g|battle}} to earn the Gym Badges. After [[Misty's Psyduck]] messed everything up due to its inability to swim, Kinso refused to give them the Gym Badges. Upon noticing [[Gym Badge thieves|two boys]] with a {{p|Zigzagoon}} and {{p|Poochyena}} stealing the Badges he worked on, including the Badges Misty, Tracey, and Sakura made, Kinso alerted the trio of the theft and they helped him get the Badges back. In the end, after witnessing Misty's Psyduck defeat the thieves' Pokémon, Kinso decided to give Misty the Badges. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kinso |pkmn=Feraligatr |type1=water |img=Kinso Feraligatr.png |epnum=HS05 |epname=The Blue Badge of Courage |desc={{p|Feraligatr}} was seen briefly when Kinso challenged {{an|Misty}} to a Pokémon battle. Intent on using {{TP|Misty|Corsola}}, {{TP|Misty|Psyduck}} came out instead, but due to it being scared of Feraligatr, it attempted to run away only to fall down a hill and into some water, in which it struggled to swim. Kinso declared no respectable [[Gym Leader]] would have a {{type|Water}} Pokémon that couldn't swim, and thus canceled the battle. None of Feraligatr's moves are known.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{water color}}|bordercolor={{water color light}} |ja=若本規夫 ''Norio Wakamoto'' |en=Corey James |it=Mario Scarabelli |pt_br=Fábio Vilalonga |es_eu=Mario Martín |es_la=Armando Rendiz}}
